title: fix(types): a nav item's visible takes the spec's expression input (envelope accepted, blank string refused)
body:
Fixes #13075
Clause-②: yes

## What changes

`@object-ui/types`' navigation mirror typed an entry's `visible` as `boolean | string`. The spec types every navigation branch's `visible` as `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema`, so the two disagreed both ways: the mirror refused the `{ dialect, source }` envelope the spec accepts, and accepted a blank string the spec refuses.

- `packages/types/src/zod/app.zod.ts`: `NavigationItemObject.visible` is now `NavigationVisibleSchema`. Its accept set is `boolean`, a string, or the spec's own `EvaluatedExpressionSchema` (by reference). Every non-boolean value is handed to the spec's `EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema` (imported from `@objectstack/spec/shared`, not restated), and that schema's issues are the refusal, with the spec's code, path and sentence. The spec's string transform is not taken: this mirror writes nothing into an author's document (decision batches #69 / #90), so a bare string stays a string. This is the same spelling `visibleWhen`'s wire uses in `base.zod.ts`. The judge runs only on a value an arm already took, so one fault is reported once. The `doc` arm reads the same slot, so it changes the same way.
- `packages/types/src/app.ts`: `NavigationItem['visible']` is `boolean | EvaluatedExpressionInput`, the spec's input type by reference.
- `navigation-spec-parity.test.ts`: a new block pins parity both ways. The envelope is accepted by both, a blank or whitespace string is refused by both with the same code and sentence, and a blank `source` inside the envelope is refused by both once at `visible.source`. The `visible: boolean` row stays as the one recorded divergence, with its existing reason.
- Consumer widenings, type-only, under seat ruling `6276914186` (A). Three callback parameters change from `string | boolean | undefined` to `NavigationItem['visible']`: layout's exported `VisibilityEvaluator` (`NavigationRenderer.tsx`), and the `evalVis` callbacks in app-shell's `hooks/useNavMemberGates.ts` and `views/nav-menu-renderer.tsx`. A fourth site, `packages/app-shell/src/layout/__tests__/navItemVisibleEvaluated.test.tsx`, has two callback annotations widened the same way. app-shell's `tsconfig.test.json` found it (3x TS2322 under `strictFunctionTypes`). There is no runtime change: every reader already passes the value to `defaultVisibility` / `evaluateNavigationVisibility`, which handle the envelope.
- `.changeset/13075-nav-visible-envelope.md`: `@object-ui/types` `minor` (widening by envelope, breaking narrowing on blank strings). `@object-ui/layout` `minor`, because `VisibilityEvaluator` is on the package entry through `export * from './NavigationRenderer'`, and widening a callback parameter breaks a host evaluator annotated with the old narrower type. `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`, because nothing widened there is on its entry.

## Reach (measured from source)

- **Producer:** `defineApp` in `@objectstack/spec` (`packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`) returns `AppSchema.parse(config)`. The spec's parse rewrites a `visible` string into `{ dialect: 'cel', source }`, so any app authored through it carries the envelope from then on. The spec also documents the envelope as the slot's normal form. Not measured: an end-to-end read of a served app's navigation through the console.
- **Renderer:** the console already evaluates an envelope `visible`. `evaluateNavigationVisibility` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `ExpressionProvider.tsx`) takes `string | boolean | { dialect, source }` and hands it to `ExpressionEvaluator.evaluateCondition`, which routes a CEL envelope to the CEL engine. `providers/__tests__/navigationVisibility-12700.test.ts` pins it with envelopes. There is no renderer gap.

## Pins and ablation

- (a) The envelope parses on `NavigationItemSchema`, for a url entry and a doc entry, and is kept as written.
- (b) `''` and `'   '` are refused by both schemas: `invalid_union @ visible`, with the same sentence.
- (c) Controls: a bare non-blank string parses and is not rewritten; `true` and `false` still parse on the mirror and are refused by the spec.
- The envelope used in the pins reads no `data`. The card's own example (`data.total == 1`) is now refused by the spec's data-source rule. That rule is objectui#13076's chain, and that card's `superRefine` hook is left alone here.

Ablation at `46731c3293`: `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (objectstack) put back `visible: z.union([z.boolean(), z.string()]).optional()` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `9e64d7e86420` to `cc23dad3b72b`). `navigation-spec-parity.test.ts` then went `6 failed | 45 passed`. The failures were the two envelope rows, the two blank-string rows on the url entry, the blank-`source` row and the typed-envelope row. The controls stayed green. The restore was proven by blob hash: after the restore the blob was `9e64d7e86420`, equal to the HEAD blob, and `git diff HEAD` was empty.

## Gates

- The closure build `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...' build` (covers types and layout) exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/layout type-check` exited 0.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` exited 0. Its first run was red: 3x TS2322 in `navItemVisibleEvaluated.test.tsx`, fixed as above.
- Nav tests: every layout / app-shell test file naming `useNavMemberGates`, `nav-menu-renderer` or `NavigationRenderer`, plus `navigationVisibility-12700`. layout: 22 files / 260 tests passed. app-shell: 26 files / 158 tests passed.
- The pre-tsc battery and the changeset scripts all exited 0. `check:spec-floors` exited 1 with `no-artifact`, as before.
- Narrowed eslint over the 7 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors and 37 warnings, all existing and none on touched lines.

At `46731c3293` (the types half, unchanged since):

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check`: exit 0. `tsconfig.test.json` lists `navigation-spec-parity.test.ts` (checked with `--listFilesOnly`).
- Targeted vitest: `navigation-spec-parity` + `spec-derived-unions` gave 64/64 passed. The 27 test files in `packages/types` that name `app.zod`, `../app.js` or `NavigationItemSchema`, plus `imported-defaults-8317`, gave `887 passed (887)`. The full `packages/types/` directory is declared to CI and was not run locally (per the dispatch's lock clause).
- `eslint --format json` over the three changed `.ts` files: 3 files, 0 errors, 1 warning. The warning is the existing `z.ZodType` any on `NavigationItemSchema`, not new. `eslint.config.js` does not enable type-aware linting, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.
- Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `check:new-line-citations`. `check:spec-floors` exited 1 with `no-artifact` (the workspace is not built); per the dispatch this is recorded and not fixed.

## Acceptance notes

- The flat mirror's spelling follows the `visibleWhen` precedent (`base.zod.ts`, `VisibleWhenInputSchema`), not a literal `z.union([z.boolean(), EvaluatedExpressionInputSchema])`. The literal union would rewrite every string `visible` into an envelope at parse, against decision batches #69 / #90. It would also turn red the existing `doc` row that asserts the mirror keeps a string `visible` as written.
